batch: Six complete own-seat histories per update: four normal scenes cycling six fit profiles, one exact recorded failure prefix with only corrected root supervised, one successful old-parent synthetic combo trajectory for KL only. All arms execute the same padded sequences; coefficients implement ablations. No exact FLOPs claim.
retention: Current || anchor KL uses the old successful 0fbf model only on its independently audited synthetic combo trajectory. Existing 24-scene CE and KL against the frozen starting 94e7 model stay identical across arms. Parent and student reconstruct their own RNN from declared episode starts; no stored RNN transplant.
admission: Replay every recorded observation/menu/core response through step20; two identical branches for original attack versus Main2, independent core audit, same root. Raye activation is a legal prefix, never a negative label. Check starting model logits against recorded failure; audit old parent's successful combo twice before admitting the anchor.
split: Same development families as prior study. Old synthetic combo is explicitly reclassified from evaluation-only to development rehearsal for the retention arm; never claim its recovery as holdout transfer. Other three synthetic cases and three reserved normal profile combinations receive zero training weight. One source candidate only, not a general automatic labeler.
evaluation: Before and each fixed endpoint: previous 73 normal takeover settings and four synthetic cases, twice each with independent audit; plus exact failure-prefix takeover twice. Intermediate probes only original base/seat-low openings and exact failure root. No reserved-result tuning or checkpoint selection.
success_gate: Correct_retain must pass all73 normal settings, exact failure continuation, and restore synthetic combo; other synthetic regressions reported separately and all78 required for complete exercise gate. No production promotion or full-game-strength claim.
stop: Frozen1024 updates per arm; stop on nonfinite outputs/gradients, history mismatch, rejected audit, asset drift, or timeout. No automatic extension, PPO, reward changes or native replacement. Save models, logs, hashes and source evidence.
